content: Verification Step: Once the system has obtained all the necessary information (i.e., ID is complete), it proceeds to the final verification. In that step, the collected data is shown to the student in the session. The student is asked to verify the correctness of the collected data and if some entries are wrong, to correct them. The ID is, where necessary, updated with the user-provided data. This procedure repeats until the user confirms the correctness of the assembled data.
